identity.proof: sha256 fingerprint from a separately issued trusted registry of random per-seat capabilities stored outside the repository
identity.secret_storage: Git-local or external secret store; never committed, logged, or placed in a wake packet

rules: Every mutation requires expected current_hash compare-and-swap.
The exact sealed lease and current append-only event tail are CAS inputs to one recoverable journal transaction.
The target seat proves possession of its capability; the issuer cannot self-author that proof.
One active claim owns one ticket, lease, ref, and non-overlapping path set.
Expiry releases no path by itself; IT Manager III performs an audited recover transition.
Events are append-only and hash chained; secrets and raw capability proofs are never recorded.
Claim transfer changes no Project, protected ref, deployment, publication, or release state.
The live watcher may transfer only an existing canonical claim after a safe tracked AgentOps offer; it never creates claims or seat identities.
rollback: Reapply the prior claim body through a new CAS transition and audit event; never rewrite or delete history.
